## Product

Name: DraftWise
Slogan: Every draft checked. Every change explained.
Description: DraftWise is a shipping document verification tool that compares draft bills of lading against original shipping instructions, surfaces mismatches with source evidence, and tracks corrections through every returned draft.

## Public pages

- Landing: https://draftwise.app/
- Workflow explanation: https://draftwise.app/workflow
- Pricing: https://draftwise.app/pricing
- Privacy policy: https://draftwise.app/privacy
- Terms of service: https://draftwise.app/terms
- Demo (no sign-in): https://draftwise.app/demo

## Capability boundaries (accurate as of September 2026)

- Compares seven fields between shipping instructions and draft bills of lading: shipper, consignee, notify party, port of loading, port of discharge, container count, gross weight.
- Classifies emails into five categories: BL_COMPARISON, SI_REQUEST, INVOICE_QUERY, GENERAL, SPAM.
- Detects suspected phishing using static signal analysis (no external link fetching).
- Monitors classification distribution for concept drift.
- Provides a read-only workspace assistant that cites case and report data.
- Demo workspace uses the provided sample dataset of 520 emails and 250 documents.
- Extraction accuracy depends on document quality, format, and language.
- Completed checks confirm document consistency — they do not authorize cargo release.
- Does not claim 100% accuracy or verified operational savings.

## Not included

- Email sending or modification
- Legal document review or authorization
- Cargo release or shipping authorization
- Real-time tracking or carrier integration
- Personal data outside of the document verification workflow
